--attention-backend.help: The attention backend to use. If two backends are specified, the first one is used for prefill and the second one for decode.

--cache-type.help: KV cache strategy (naive | radix). For hybrid GDN models 'radix' is materialized as a GDN-aware radix (cross-request GDN-state prefix reuse); pass 'naive' to opt out.

--cors-origins.help: Comma-separated CORS allow-list for browser/webview clients (default: local Tauri/Vite dev origins). '' disables, '*' allows any.

--cuda-graph-max-bs.help: The maximum batch size for CUDA graph capture. None means auto-tuning based on the GPU memory.

--decode-log-interval.help: Print one decode scheduler status line every N decode forwards.

--disable-moe-prefill-overlap.help: Disable two-buffer overlap for prefill MoE expert copies. By default, prefill overlap is enabled and requires --moe-cache-size >= 2 * num_experts.

--dtype.help: Data type for model weights and activations. 'auto' will use FP16 for FP32/FP16 models and BF16 for BF16 models.

--enable-cache-report.help: Return the number of prefix-cached prompt tokens in each response's usage block (OpenAI usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, Anthropic usage.cache_read_input_tokens, Responses usage.input_tokens

--enable-special-token-ckpt.help: Checkpoint decode state at special tokens (currently the tool-call opener). When a GDN-hybrid or SWA model samples its tool-call opener token, the scheduler preserves a reuse point just after it (GDN:

--expert-load.help: How MoE expert banks are read into host RAM. 'auto' (default) reads scattered experts in parallel (fast) but falls back to serial when free RAM can't cover the banks + the parallel reader's extra whol

--gpu.help: GPU(s) to run on, comma-separated; entry i is TP rank i. Each entry is a GPU UUID (GPU-xxxx..., as nvidia-smi -L prints) or an nvidia-smi index

--host.help: The host address for the server.

--kv-reserve-tokens.help: KV-cache token floor reserved before --moe-cache-auto fills experts.

--max-output-tokens.help: Default max output tokens for requests that omit one (default 32k).

--max-prefill-length.help: Chunk Prefill maximum chunk size in tokens.

--max-running-requests.help: The maximum number of running requests.

--memory-ratio.help: Fraction of total GPU free memory the engine may use for weights + MoE cache + KV cache combined; the remainder is reserved runtime headroom.

--model-path.help: The path of the model weights. This can be a local folder or a Hugging Face repo ID.

--model-source.help: The source to download model from. Either 'huggingface' or 'modelscope'.

--moe-cache-auto.help: Auto-pick --moe-cache-size from free VRAM and expert size, MoE-priority (KV gets --kv-reserve-tokens as a floor). Not supported for owned-KV models.

--moe-cache-policy.help: The unified MoE cache eviction policy.

--moe-cache-rate.help: The fraction of all MoE experts to keep in GPU cache.

--moe-cache-size.help: The number of unified MoE expert slots on GPU.

--moe-cpu-layers.help: With --moe-strategy offload/hybrid: which MoE layers compute on the CPU executor instead of the GPU offload/PCIe path (where CUDA pinning is quota-capped, e.g. WSL, their banks are OS-locked instead o

--moe-cpu-threads.help: Number of CPU worker threads for --moe-strategy cpu decode experts. 0 = auto (physical cores).

--moe-hybrid-max-fetch.help: For --moe-strategy hybrid: max experts fetched over PCIe per (layer, decode step); the rest of that step's misses are computed on the CPU, overlapped. -1 (default) = auto: fetch the benched pcie/cpu b

--moe-prefill-hit-d2d.help: During prefill prefetch, copy cache-resident experts device-side into the double buffer and stream only the misses over PCIe (cudaMemcpyBatchAsync, CUDA >= 13.0). Effective with --moe-cache-size > 2 *

--moe-strategy.help: How the routed experts are served. 'auto' resolves a MoE model to the offload family (offload, or hybrid when a `ft bench bw` profile recommends it); resident 'fused' experts must be requested explici

--num-pages.help: Set the maximum number of pages for KVCache.

--num-tokenizer.help: The number of tokenizer processes to launch. 0 means the tokenizer is shared with the detokenizer.

--num-tokens.help: Total KV-cache capacity in tokens; must be a multiple of the resolved page size (DSV4: 128 window page, TRTLLM backend: 64). Mutually exclusive with --num-pages.

--page-size.help: Set the page size for system management.

--ple-backend.help: Where a PLE n-gram table lives. 'disk' (default) reads rows straight from the checkpoint files; 'pinned' preloads the whole table into page-locked host RAM.

--port.help: The port number for the server to listen on.

--quant-backend.help: Kernel per quantized layer type: comma-separated layer[.kind]=name entries, e.g. 'linear=marlin,moe=b12x' or 'moe.nvfp4=triton'. A layer-level entry applies to every kind whose kernel table lists the

--reasoning-parser.help: Reasoning parser that splits chain-of-thought into reasoning_content for OpenAI responses. 'auto' selects per model family (gpt-oss Harmony, <think> for qwen3/glm/minimax, <mm:think> for minimax-m3, A

--sampling-defaults.help: Source for unspecified request sampling params. 'model' fills temperature/top_k/top_p from the checkpoint's generation_config.json (recommended for reasoning models to avoid greedy repetition loops);

--served-model-name.help: Model id returned by /v1/models. Defaults to the basename of --model.

--shell-mode.help: Run the server in shell mode.

--tool-call-parser.help: Tool-call parser format for OpenAI-compatible tool responses.
